author: AISecurityInst
text:
The more capable models become, the harder it is to safely evaluate them - but it’s essential that AI agents are tested.

Sandboxes are isolated environments for testing & monitoring AI behaviour. Our Inspect Sandboxing Toolkit is tailor-made for secure, scalable evaluations 🧵 https://t.co/CIYc6O6lJE

author: AISecurityInst
text: In August we committed to strengthening our security following an incident in which an agent took unsanctioned actions during a cyber evaluation. We are now sharing an update on our progress, and what's coming next: 🧵 https://t.co/k7HQl0DcTZ

author: AISecurityInst
text: This is one phase of a continuous effort - as capabilities advance, we will adapt and develop our security practices to keep pace.

author: AISecurityInst
text:
We're setting out our work as openly as we can in the hope it helps those doing similar work, and we encourage others to share their approaches too.

Read the full blog: https://t.co/uPc7UOTpMZ

author: AISecurityInst
text: AI companies deploy safeguards that are robust to thousands of hours of human attacks. Today, we share Boundary Point Jailbreaking (BPJ), the first fully automated attack to break the safeguards of leading AI models🧵 (1/8) https://t.co/rG6tveEzm6
